title: Weekly Test 02
instructions: Answer all questions carefully. 30 MCQs, 2 marks each (60 marks). Duration 75 minutes. One attempt. Use radian measure unless a degree is written.

questions.prompt: In △ABC, ∠B = 90°. If tan A = 5/12, then sin A + cos A equals
questions.explanation: Opposite = 5, adjacent = 12, hypotenuse = 13. So sin A = 5/13, cos A = 12/13 and their sum is 17/13.

questions.prompt: If sec θ − tan θ = 1/2, then sec θ + tan θ equals
questions.explanation: (sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ) = sec²θ − tan²θ = 1. Therefore sec θ + tan θ = 1/(1/2) = 2.

questions.prompt: If sin θ + cos θ = √2, then tan θ + cot θ equals
questions.explanation: Square: 1 + sin 2θ = 2 ⇒ sin 2θ = 1 ⇒ θ = π/4 (acute). Then tan θ + cot θ = 1 + 1 = 2.

questions.explanation: h/x = 1/√3 and h/(x − 20) = √3. Solving gives h = 10√3 m.

questions.explanation: This expression is tan 2θ = 2(1/2)/(1 − 1/4) = 1/(3/4) = 4/3.

questions.prompt: A circular disc of radius 10 cm subtends 0.04 rad at the eye. Using the small-angle approximation, the diameter of the disc as seen is about
questions.explanation: For small θ, θ ≈ (diameter)/distance. Here distance = 10 cm, θ = 0.04 ⇒ diameter ≈ 0.4 cm.

questions.prompt: The maximum value of 5 sin θ + 12 cos θ − 7 is
questions.explanation: Max of 5 sin θ + 12 cos θ is √(25+144) = 13. Hence maximum of the expression is 13 − 7 = 6.

questions.explanation: 3 sin θ + 4 cos θ lies in [−5, 5], so f lies in [2 − 5, 2 + 5] = [−3, 7].

questions.explanation: Phase difference = π/2, so resultant amplitude = √(4² + 3²) = 5.

questions.explanation: Parallel line: 3x + 4y + k = 0. Using (2, −3): 6 − 12 + k = 0 ⇒ k = 6.

questions.explanation: 8 = ½ a (2)² ⇒ a = 4 m/s². In 4 s, s = 32 m. So next 2 s cover 32 − 8 = 24 m.

questions.explanation: Displacement = area of triangle = ½ × 5 × 10 = 25 m.
